Rates are session averages, rounded to 2 decimal places.

A note on the math ＋

Net mesos = (ending mesos − starting mesos) − (HP used × HP cost) − (MP used × MP cost).

Each rate = total gain ÷ elapsed seconds × 3,600, 600, or 60. Time spent entering ending values is excluded. Negative gains and losses are preserved.

Use one distinct supply per slot. For a potion that restores both HP and MP, count it in one slot only. Custom items require your own unit price.
